My plot is only a quarter hectare, and maize is what feeds my family, so I must do my best with what little I have. I will try to buy a small bag of fertilizer if the AIP coupon reaches me this year, but I cannot afford much, and I will also put the manure from my goats around the planting stations. I plant together with pigeon peas so the soil stays strong, and I save seed from last year because hybrid seed is expensive at the market. I do all the weeding myself with my hoe — I cannot pay for workers.
